overview_description.description: Taiv is an advertising technology company that provides AI-driven media solutions to transform how businesses manage and monetize television screens in venues like bars, restaurants, and retail locations. Its platform includes a small hardware device that connects to existing TVs to detect commercial breaks in real time and automatically replace or overlay content with venue-specific promotions, partner ads, trivia, and branded messaging tailored to on-site audiences. Taiv also offers a web-based management interface that lets venue operators schedule content, control what appears on displays, and access revenue reporting for ads shown in their establishments. The company’s technology integrates AI and computer vision to monitor live feeds and switch inputs without disrupting traditional viewing experiences, enabling targeted advertising and digital signage workflows that align with business goals. Taiv works with media buyers, brands, and venue owners to deliver measurable ad placements and engage patrons with customized content while providing a new revenue stream through shared ad monetization. Its services include installation, content automation, and remote scheduling support that help venues optimize screen usage and audience engagement.

about_short_description.short_description: Taiv is an advertising technology company that provides AI-driven media solutions to manage and monetize television screens in venues.

product.name: Taiv TV Enhancement System
product.description: A hardware and software solution that connects to existing cable boxes to replace live TV commercials with venue-specific advertisements and content.

product.name: Digital Signage Management
product.description: A service that enables venues to schedule and display custom media content on their TVs, rotating through content loops based on time or day.

product.name: Streaming Content Channels
product.description: Short-form, audio-optional video content that plays automatically on venue TVs when no other content is scheduled.

product.name: Interactive Trivia Feature
product.description: An automated trivia game that plays on venue TVs during commercial breaks or intermissions to entertain customers.

product.name: Advertising Revenue Sharing Program
product.description: A program that allows venues to earn revenue by displaying targeted advertisements during commercial breaks on their TVs.
